name: Chroma (self-operated software)
description: Self-operated software release, not a hosted-service plan. Canonical metrics are supported families; score transforms and representation-specific limits remain in the linked research note. Runtime configuration, access enforcement and operational costs require separate evidence.

provenance.notes: l2, cosine and ip map to Euclidean, Cosine and InnerProduct. Returned l2 is squared Euclidean; ip returns one minus dot product. Canonical names identify metric families, not comparable raw score units.
HNSW and SPANN are separate configurations and cannot both be supplied. This does not establish cloud plan availability or an ACL boundary.

Apache-2.0 software license. No-charge software use is distinct from hosting, storage and operations costs; comply with license/NOTICE and redistribution conditions. No customer-content or hosted-service rights inferred.
Publisher release/tag pin resolves to commit 11f3c7435e71024aa0a2b53710a28d3289d922d1. No installed runtime or benchmark was exercised.
